completion_liveness_contract.principle: symmetric to monitor_contract.forbidden: the runner must not fabricate FAILURE any more than it fabricates success. A completion attempt that finds no declared event must not terminalize an agent that is still alive, still producing, or whose valid event merely arrived late. This is the dual the v1 contract omitted and TASK-093 exploited (event landed ~4.5 min after 'retries exhausted').
completion_liveness_contract.liveness_wins: when no completion event matches, an agent whose completion session is alive and (process-alive OR output-changed) is returned as await-liveness, never exhausted/failed (evaluateAgentLiveness -> completion-runner.ts). Mirrors watchdog_contract.alive_source, applied to completion rather than reaping.
completion_liveness_contract.bounded_await: await-liveness is capped at maxExtensions (default 6) so a genuinely hung-but-alive agent still terminates; the extension count MUST be persisted across completion re-entries or await never converges (infinite defer).
completion_liveness_contract.handoff_artifact_salvage: before failing an agent with no declared event, synthesize completion from a non-empty durable handoff artifact ({agentId}-summary.json/.md); generalized beyond the generation-only no_emit_salvage carve-out (completion-runner.ts synthesizeCompletionEventFromHandoff).
completion_liveness_contract.late_event_recovery: a valid unprocessed completion event that lands after a premature completion_failed re-completes the agent and reopens the run for downstream (recoverLateCompletionEvents); idempotent on latest-attempt=completion_failed. Parity of the bash monitor-agent-died 'process gone but completion event exists ... completing normally' path.
completion_liveness_contract.events_dir_read: the matcher always reads the project/namespace events dir in addition to EVENTS_DIR and runDir/events (readEventsFromDirs), so a valid event in the project dir is never missed when EVENTS_DIR points elsewhere or runDir/events is absent (completion-entrypoint.ts).

coverage.events_dir_read: LIVE - completion-entrypoint reads [EVENTS_DIR, projectEventsDir, runDir/events] deduped, unconditional
coverage.handoff_artifact_salvage: LIVE - completeAgent calls synthesizeCompletionEventFromHandoff before any fail path
coverage.liveness_wins: LIVE - completion-entrypoint resolves the run-scoped PTY daemon, feeds AgentLivenessInput into runCompletionPipeline, and records durable completionLiveness extensions
coverage.bounded_await: LIVE - completion-entrypoint persists extensionCount in run.runnerV2.completionLiveness and clears it after a non-await verdict
coverage.late_event_recovery: LIVE - app/api/tasks/reconcile/route.ts invokes recoverLateCompletionEvents before retry/audit handling for stale terminal auto-runs, reopens the run status returned by recovery, builds a typed executor route plan for each recovered completion, and applies it so downstream launches resume
